purpose: Measure how much useful cognitive work one owned worker can complete locally between one externally timestamped start marker and one final result bundle, while changing only the local production discipline.
invariants: Fresh worker identity and normal POOL authority remain unchanged.
The owned job and fixture are identical across variants.
No web, repo, file, search or other tool call is allowed between the durable batch-start marker and the final result-bundle write.
No variant may lower output requirements, skip the final audit or claim external verification it did not perform.
Speed is diagnostic only; completeness and constraint retention dominate.

variants.changed_rule: After the batch-start marker, execute A1→A8 consecutively from the loaded fixture and run one full local audit at the end.
After the batch-start marker, execute A1→A8 consecutively but run a local no-tool audit after every two atoms, repairing locally before continuing; still one final external result bundle.
Before each atom, internally fill objective, constraints, done_when and output_shape from the fixture, then execute it; no prose planning and no external I/O; one final audit and result bundle.

exploration_design.next_gate: At most one candidate may move to >=3 independent confirmations only after exact bundles and external marker→return timing are compared.

synthetic_context.description: A personal system that receives text notes and converts them into durable IDEA, ACCION or REFERENCIA records and bounded work.

classification.IDEA: Something to remember, explore, design or develop.
classification.REFERENCIA: Information to preserve that does not itself create work.

laws: Do not silently convert IDEA into ACCION.
Outputs must be precise enough for another system to consume.

atoms.output: Classify 30 provided synthetic notes; each row number|category|reason 8–18 words; include exact category totals.
input: Quiero probar una interfaz de voz para capturar ideas.
Enviar el informe mañana antes de las 18.
El runtime actual usa Node 22.
Sería útil medir cuánto espera cada worker.
Comparar hoy dos propuestas de navegación.
El prototipo anterior guardaba estado en localStorage.
Explorar si un batch local reduce consultas externas.
Quizás tener una radio personal.
Guardar que el último canary fue no autoritativo.
Corregir el reload de Notes antes de integrar voz.
Pensar una visualización de proyectos como nodos.
El archivo principal se llama index.html.
Probar mañana voz→nota→clasificación.
Me gustaría poder mover widgets.
Registrar latencias del próximo experimento.
GitHub Pages sirve la proyección pública.
Diseñar alguna vez un check-in de hábitos.
Verificar ahora si el thread persiste al reload.
Recordar que el worker previo no usó tools localmente.
Explorar batches de cincuenta decisiones.
Agregar una prueba para JSON inválido.
El canary usa un Chat Object existente.
Tal vez las respuestas puedan incluir audio.
Medir colisiones entre diez workers.
Revisar el contrato antes de tocar autoridad.
El porcentaje debe salir de pasos ponderados.
Probar dos tamaños de output largo.
Conservar una alternativa visual rechazada.
Hoy quiero publicar el resultado visible.
La telemetría no debe convertirse en authority.

atoms.output: For 8 synthetic paragraphs return JSON objects with exactly objective,input,processing,output,boundary,ambiguity.
atoms.requirement: Each object must preserve meaning and avoid invented implementation details.

atoms.output: Write four independent 280–360 word specs: durable chat input, worker local batching, external timing, and progress widget. Each must include PROBLEMA,HIPOTESIS,ENTRADA,PROCESO,MEDIDAS,EXITO,NO_OBJETIVOS.
For four objectives (durable input, batch worker, timing harness, chat progress) produce exactly 10 atomic-but-meaningful tasks each; <=22 words/task; each separately verifiable.

Compare DIRECT, BLOCK_AUDIT and FILL_TEMPLATE in a structured matrix across expected quality, instruction retention, local overhead, external I/O, integration cost and likely failure modes; do not declare a winner.
Given the experiment laws and outputs A1–A5, identify at least 12 possible failure modes, classify each as detectable locally, detectable externally, or ambiguous, and specify evidence needed.
Draft a 700–900 word candidate Worker Playbook section explaining large atoms, local batching, external boundaries, verification and when to stop batching. Clearly mark it CANDIDATE, not baseline.

Audit A1–A7 against every count/range/schema/law; repair locally; return exact counts, constraint failures before repair, repairs performed, unresolved ambiguities and late-batch degradation yes/no with evidence.

measurement.external_clock_rule: Use GitHub durable artifact/commit timestamps for marker→result elapsed; model-authored timestamps remain diagnostic only.
measurement.intermediate_external_io: FORBIDDEN between successful START marker persistence and first RESULT bundle persistence unless an explicit safety/authority/runtime boundary makes the run invalid.
